title: PHYS-HINGE-VIEWER-01: Display live public disjoint hinge states with recovery and cleanup
body:
## Goal, parents and status

Parent #1489; product #1179/#660. A developer must see the accepted motion of two disjoint hinge components produced by the package's **public createPhysicsWorld**, not a private factory or a saved recording.

**PLANNED. No implementation, builds, public World steps or actual screen flow have run.** Recorded-data Viewer result9330df8f/ba4f0683 is a reusable display/lifecycle reference only. Existing #1073 remains a different two-body/one-joint/2s robot consumer; #1279 remains private reference.

## Start gates

- #1489 must reach its selected physical/API/identity-model GO and exact local Integration adoption, with retained own build and source/genuine compiled numerical proof. No guessed ID/order support.
- Freeze this host's actual public providers, consumer/source/data, actual emitted closure, geometry/camera/bindings, error/cursor policy and native driver before calls. Existing public Viewer APIs must support the selected four packets; no private provider aliases.
- Current Integration Save/Open/recovery follow-ups are tracked in #674/#1254. Those unrun composed checks alone do not block a correctly adopted dependency.

## Consumer, units, scene and ownership

Physics owns only new `examples/physics-public-disjoint-hinge-viewer/**`. Split World host, fixed-step clock, Viewer adapter, display geometry, UI and native verifier. No package/root/lock/Viewer/GPU/CAD changes are authorized by this card.

Use the unchanged #1489 original4sphere/2hinge physical fixture, zero gravity/initial motion, dt1/120s,1200steps/10s, existing caps/limits and empty commands. Only the actually qualified ID/order scope may be selected. SI/radians stay in Physics/labels; metres convert to millimetres only at Viewer adapter; quaternion and RH-Y-up basis stay unchanged.

Use existing public Viewer setPackets/applyMotionFrame/getState/setView/dispose and generic derived sphere+orientation witness packets. Four original body IDs bind to four distinct model/surface refs. Radius100mm and orientation witness are display proxies, not exact CAD/collision geometry. No new GPU Physics or Viewer capacity Issue is justified by this planned reuse.

## Runtime contract

Play/Pause/one step/Reset operate the actual public World. Each step calls World once, validates copied accepted state, then submits one complete Viewer frame. Keep two values: accepted Physics cursor and last confirmed displayed cursor. A Viewer failure AFTER World acceptance does not roll back Physics and must not claim the frame was displayed. Pause, retain accepted state, mark display unknown when necessary and retry ONLY its current display frame, with zero additional Physics step. Never render a refused attempted state.

Context loss pauses/cancels the clock, retains copied accepted Physics state, disposes Viewer and clears display confirmation. Restoration does not autoplay. Explicit display recovery creates a new Viewer and submits the current accepted World state without a Physics step. Reset is different: dispose the old World/Viewer and create a fresh admitted initial World at cursor0. Dispose is idempotent, cancels RAF and forbids later submissions/steps.

Labels distinguish joint limit197/time1.641666667s from natural completion1200/time10s. Only public accepted joint/body fields are displayed; no private motor-work getter, observer, fabricated force or calibrated-load claim. The qualified component domain excludes cross-pair contacts and a general connected joint network.

## One bounded native flow and exact acceptance

After source/emitted/runtime freeze, execute one source and one genuine compiled public consumer flow with real Chrome/WebGL2. Freeze exact viewport/camera/geometry and all trial/call counts first. Before code, set a maximum accepted-step/call budget that accounts separately for UI prelude, main replay and refused attempts; do not relabel UI setup as part of the1200 main steps.

- Inspect exact body/ref/unit/quaternion mapping and public-vs-displayed cursor at0/1/60/197/1200. Actual pixels and initial/moving/final PNGs must be nonblank and visually inspected.
- Actual Play→Pause retains state; one step advances once; Reset returns fresh initial state. Main natural playback accepts and displays exactly1200 steps and stops at10 saved seconds with no pending RAF.
- Verify a selected public refusal from #1489 without relaxing caps or exposing a force UI; keep complete accepted state and shown cursor semantics. A host validation control can be private to the verifier and must not claim a new public API.
- Actual context loss/recovery re-presents retained current accepted state without additional World calls, remains paused, then separate Reset returns0.
- Dispose both objects twice; tracked GPU resources/bytes and RAF reach0; actual subsequent calls refuse with their existing codes; no post-dispose draw/step occurs. Preserve first failures and bounded repair receipts.
- Source and compiled paths use their own actual public providers. Record import graph, source/emitted/build hashes, raw copied accepted state/pose correspondence, browser/runtime/endpoint/elapsed time and all cleanup results. No repeated private numerical/reference campaign is needed.

Exact Integration handoff and scoped receipts close only this host card. Mark current composed follow-ups `merged; integration validation pending`. No CAD topology, force calibration, generic network/contact/CCD, cross-platform replay, FPS/Box3D parity, global engine or release result follows. No product push/PR/deployment/publication.

## Plan links and duplicate check

[CPU public contract](https://github.com/barocss/barocss/wiki/Physics-Public-Disjoint-Hinge-Plan)
[Live Viewer plan](https://github.com/barocss/barocss/wiki/Physics-Public-Disjoint-Hinge-Viewer-Plan)
[Product roadmap](https://github.com/barocss/barocss/wiki/Physics-Product-Roadmap)

All-state searches public/disjoint/hinge/Viewer and HINGE2/Viewer found no live public four-body delivery card. Existing1073 original one-joint fixture was read directly; it is not replaced or closed by this card.
